'''Pen'thruta''' was a [[biochemist]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Pen'thruta managed a small shop, also teaching the knowledge of biochemistry to others.
